rules: CORE_MASTER.json is the only editable shared protocol authority for 0.7.2.
CORE.md and locale CORE.txt files are generated views, not parallel masters.
PLAYER is private owner state and does not modify shared CORE unless an explicit canon decision is separately recorded.
Older CORE/release files are provenance only unless this pointer is explicitly replaced by a newer verified pointer.

All 77 original approved grouped mechanisms, names and definitions are required in the current source and generated CORE. Missing retrieval never downgrades this requirement. SAVE includes the explicit system-state correction.
External sync-runtime is a separate implementation layer and cannot silently override CORE or PLAYER.
